evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline.
